title: Explicit evaluator reuse under a cold finished nested parent: a failed persistence acknowledgement can leave the old verdict on the parent's card
outcome: Explicit evaluator reuse under a cold finished nested parent: a failed persistence acknowledgement can leave the old verdict on the parent's card
acceptance: When an explicit evaluator reuse under a cold finished nested parent fails its persistence acknowledgement, the parent's card ends showing the outcome actually recorded (or is shown unchanged with evidence that nothing changed), covered by a behaviour test on the reuse path without timing thresholds.
